name: css-inlayhint
description: A LSP implementation for CSS inlay hints

scripts.release: pnpm --dir .. run compile && pnpm run compile && rm -rf dist node_modules && cp -R ../dist ./dist && cp -RL ../node_modules ./dist/node_modules && cp -R ./dist/node_modules/.pnpm/*/node_modules/* ./dist/node_modules/ && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --follow-symlinks --allow-unused-files-pattern --out css-inlayhint-0.0.2.vsix
